semantic_meaning: Reveals the system blueprint: stable structure, constraints, and interfaces.
when_to_use: When introducing a system architecture quickly
When switching from narrative to schematic structure
As a calm reset after high-density segments
when_not_to_use: If it becomes a static slide (must animate)
If a mechanism reveal would be more appropriate
To imply certainty for unknown internals

animation_behavior.description: Grid/edges draw in cyan; labels fade in; optional amber marker for a single interface/leverage point.

input_parameters.name: focus_interface_id
input_parameters.description: Optional interface to mark in amber.

expected_outputs: A clean blueprint scaffold readable on mobile
validation_notes: Avoid static holds; use layered reveals to enforce motion cadence.
